requirements.adequate_response: State: organisation of workers that represents them in dealings with employers (about pay and conditions, through collective bargaining)
requirements.exam_evidence: 2021 P2 Q3(a) define + two types (4 marks; ER: well answered, 'workers' organisation represents workers in dealings with management and owners'); syllabus glossary line 897 adds 'collective bargaining'. 2020 P1 Q7 and 2024 P1 Q5 ask collective bargaining; ER 2020: learners treat bargaining as the union.
requirements.why: V-001 awards 2 marks like the exam; no standalone card defines collective bargaining (syllabus glossary names it).

requirements.syllabus_text: identify the aims of trade unions
requirements.adequate_response: Name aims: higher pay, better/safer conditions, hours, job security, fair treatment, training
requirements.exam_evidence: 2022 P2 Q4 stem (retrenchment); 2023 P1 Q16 wage rise -> cost-push inflation (link). No direct 'identify aims' question 2020-2024.
requirements.gap: Neither bank has a card on higher wages as a union aim or on hours/fair treatment
requirements.repetition: V-005 duplicates J-003 and is cued
requirements.why: J-003 open recall + V-006 application + revised V-004; add pay/hours card

requirements.syllabus_text: describe the advantages of joining a trade union
requirements.demand: Describe (give reason + consequence) with several distinct benefits
requirements.adequate_response: Give distinct benefits: negotiated pay/conditions, representation in grievances/disciplinary, legal advice, protection from unfair dismissal, training, welfare/strike pay
requirements.exam_evidence: 2022 P2 Q4(a) 'List six benefits to a worker of joining a trade union' (breadth demand, 2022); 2021 P2 Q3(d) wellbeing (unions: negotiate, training, counselling, benefits).
requirements.gap: Both cover only collective voice / grievance help. No card gives legal advice, dismissal protection, training/welfare benefits that the exam asks six of (V notes list them; no card tests them)
requirements.why: Depth from J-004 and V-009; breadth missing in both

requirements.syllabus_text: describe the types of trade unions in Namibia (e.g. white collar, blue collar, craft unions)
requirements.adequate_response: Name/define at least white collar, blue collar, craft; recognise general and industrial union also accepted

topic_summaries.strengths_V: Definition cards with 2 marks mirror exam; misconception cards for the two documented confusions (bargaining vs union; association vs union); employer-side benefit and cost; industrial action; four extended items spanning data response, short answer, case, essay.
topic_summaries.strengths_J: Clear bargaining-vs-union item, open aims recall, well-built 4-mark chains (shift concern, skill shortage), contrast pair of cases in P03; notes caution against legal claims.
topic_summaries.defects_V: Padding (002, 007, 010); mismatched/duplicative marks in 004; negative-framed wording (011, 012); P02 (g)(h) vague; P03 says 'cooperative' in a joinery-firm case.
topic_summaries.defects_J: Many 1-mark restating cards (002, 008, 010); 005 repeats 004; defs 1 mark vs exam 2; P02 (a) rewards restating stem; 006 cue-driven.
gaps: Card: Define collective bargaining (2 marks: negotiation between employer(s)/representatives and worker representatives (1) about pay/conditions (1)); accept 'process not organisation'.

Card: Describe four distinct advantages of joining a union (legal advice/representation, protection from unfair dismissal, training/welfare benefits, negotiated pay) - exam 2022 P2 Q4(a) asks six benefits.
Card: Name two employer-association roles (negotiate with unions, advise on labour law, training, lobby government, bulk buying) matching 2020 Q6.
Card/short answer: stages of resolving a dispute (negotiation, conciliation, arbitration, labour court) per 2021 P2 Q3(b) - confirm whether in scope for 2.2 or 9.1.
Card: general and industrial unions as accepted types.
Card: how a successful wage claim can raise costs and cause cost-push inflation (2023 P1 Q16).
Card: higher pay and reasonable hours as union aims.
topic_summaries.coherence: Prerequisite order is definition -> aims -> advantages -> types -> factors -> evaluation in both banks. Terminology consistent within each bank. V's 'industrial disruption' is used before industrial action is defined (027 sits at the end). Both banks use rota/shift contexts repeatedly; J reuses skill-shortage/strong-orders in 013, 015, P02, P03 (heavy repetition).
topic_summaries.notes_vs_cards: V: notes list strike pay, Labour Commissioner and picketing; no card tests them. No card contradicts notes. J: notes say not to assert statutory rights; cards comply.
nonverified_claims: V notes: legal advice before Labour Commissioner, strike pay, picketing - Namibian Labour Act rights not verified (no source in /src).
Examiner-report quotes read in 2020-2022 ER text: Q6/Q7 (2020), Q3 (2021), Q5/Q6 (2022) spot-checked; marking-scheme wording as extracted, not verified against PDF.
Existence/current names of Namibian unions not asserted by cards.

topic_summaries.strengths_V: Item for every function, quality and type of money including homogeneity (2024 Q6); correct arithmetic everywhere; central-bank functions (issue, banker, lender of last resort, supervision) and stock-exchange rationale (liquidity, new capital) as separate cards; misconception cards (unit vs store, central vs commercial).
topic_summaries.strengths_J: Chained 4-mark mechanisms (money solves barter, portability, unit of account, divisibility, transfer); exam-form 2-mark calculation; three 7-mark evaluations incl. a depreciation evaluation (2023 P2 shape); avoids unsupported demand-response claims.
topic_summaries.defects_V: Marking mismatches in 12 definition cards (marking asks a feature the answer omits); category definitions 017-019 redundant; 011 marks 'market determination' not in official wording; 029 conflicts with 2024 official counterfeit point; 008 1 mark for a 2-mark exam skill; 034 stricter than exam.
topic_summaries.defects_J: Unverified rand-peg sentences inserted into 012, 013, 014, P02, P03 (irrelevant to the skills); 013 awards a mark for peg; 003 ambiguous answer; 007 depends on another card; 015/009 compound prompts; 016 does not test a central-bank function; P02 marks an element absent from the stem.
gaps: Define depreciation/appreciation of a currency (2 marks) - only V-011 (needs fix); add appreciation definition and exporter effect.
Card: effects of depreciation on prices/inflation, exports, imports and employment (2023 P2 evaluate).
Card: name two causes of exchange rate fluctuation (2020 P1 Q21) - confirm in scope.
Card: describe four central-bank functions with development (2024 P2 23(a) 6 marks).
Card: stock exchange functions and effect on economy incl. government securities (2021 P2 8 marks).
Card: list commercial-bank functions (deposits, loans, payments) distinct from central bank.
Card: convert N$ to foreign currency (division) in 2-mark exam form.
Card: stock-exchange evaluation (J-017 revised can fill).
topic_summaries.coherence: Both follow need -> money -> exchange rate -> effects -> institutions. V uses 'foreign unit' abstractly in 008-010/P01 then US$ never; J uses US$ and N$ per US$ like the exam. V terminology consistent; J mixes peg claims into skills unrelated to it. Repetition of loan-affordability reasoning across five items.
topic_summaries.notes_vs_cards: V notes (line ~61) say homogeneity differs from anti-counterfeit protection while the 2024 official scheme credits it: card 029 follows notes, not exam. V notes list 'four' functions incl. deferred payment; cards cover all four. J notes carry the peg paragraph; cards repeat it. No other contradictions found.
nonverified_claims: J cards: N$ pegged one-to-one to the rand (Common Monetary Area) - widely stated but not verified against a source in /src or online as at 2026-11-08; time-sensitive.
J-016: 'monetary framework maintains the peg ... price stability' as central-bank objective: not verified.
V-042 repo rate definition and Bank of Namibia usage: standard definition, not verified against BoN publication.
V-040/041 lender of last resort and supervision as Bank of Namibia functions: consistent with 2023/2024 official schemes (read), not verified against statute.
Official schemes quoted from ER extracts (2020-2024) read directly; wording as extracted.

topic_summaries.defects_J: Single-mark definition; 003 mislabels labour as product-comparable; P01 double-credits; P02 (a) rewards copying; no geographic or financial types.
gaps: Card: Outline the meaning of a market (2 marks) accepting place/arrangement + buyers and sellers + exchange/negotiate price.
